_comment: Stage-1 ASC sweep after swapping in the new survey betas. 39 runs.
Centers in 'base' come from alpha_new = alpha_old - dBeta_m*Xbar_m + dU_car,
with car.alpha_u pinned at 0 as the reference, so car's own beta-driven
utility shift (dU_car ~ -0.214, placeholder Xbar: 15 min / 1.5 EUR) is carried
over onto every other mode. Replace Xbar by real per-mode means from the last
calibrated run to sharpen these centers.
bavariaDrt.alpha_u is held CONSTANT at its new survey-estimated value and is
never varied - not in the grid, not in the reference run.
Grid: PT x walk x bike = 4*3*3 = 36 runs. PT gets the finest resolution since
its waiting-time beta changed most. Step widths for walk/bike are set by the
uncertainty in dU_car (a common offset to all non-car modes), not by their own
beta changes, which are below 2 percent. Note that the all-low and all-high
corners of the grid are exactly that dU_car direction.
bavariaCarPassenger is axis-probed (2 runs) rather than gridded: its own beta
change is the largest single one, but its modal share is small.
ref_old_asc keeps the OLD ASCs of the other modes so you can see how far the
new betas alone move the split - that run validates or refutes dU_car above.
